# Support

Cinis is a personal engineering lab, not a hosted trading service. No availability or response-time SLA is provided.

Before opening an issue, read the root README, setup guide, current backlog, and relevant specifications. Use a question issue for usage/design questions, a bug report for reproducible incorrect behavior, or a work item for a scoped proposal. Discussions may be used if enabled; this scaffold does not assume they are enabled.

Include revision, OS, compiler/Python/PowerShell versions, exact command, expected/actual behavior, and a redacted log excerpt or run ID. Never post API keys, tokens, private keys, raw account data, or private environment dumps. Security reports follow SECURITY.md rather than public issues.

The maintainer may request a minimal fixture or move a proposed feature to the backlog. GitHub Issues support conversation; docs/delivery/backlog.md remains the single implementation work-item source until a deliberate migration is recorded.
